specification.primary: per-question mean KL(reference_stream || frozen_scale_reconstructed_history) minus mean KL(reference_stream || keep_compressed_history); negative favors repair
specification.scope: four CPU development cases only; no gate inference
specification.amendment: F: pre-GPU secondary contrast, robust effect summaries and numerical K8/V8 anchor

higher_precision_anchor.scope: numerical reference; accuracy cost unvalidated; not used to redefine gate

specification.secondary_contrast: mean KL(fresh-state/fresh-scales) minus KL(fresh-state/frozen-scales); paired source-question percentile 95% interval; positive favors frozen scales
specification.robustness: median absolute benefit, signs, log(KEEP/frozen) with 1e-9 floor and clipping count; leave-one-out mean range; all descriptive, no replacement of primary
specification.device_assignment: alternating questions in sorted SHA256(source-id) order: q[0::2], q[1::2]
specification.observed_allocation: two RTX 4090 24GB reported by nvidia-smi on supplied host; not the originally offered 5090s

numerical_gate.scope: numerical mechanism only; no accuracy/deployment inference

specification.controls: independent blockwise BF16 histories twice; independent full-prefill BF16 histories twice; same-cache probe repeat; per-layer KV errors; frozen-scale self-encoding identity
specification.design: 96 new source questions; within-question paired interventions; no task-accuracy claim

planning.warning: Four-case variance is uncertain; this remains exploratory, not powered confirmation.

specification.primary_test: source-question paired mean KL difference; negative favors frozen-scale history reconstruction; report all 96 effects and heterogeneity, not just a significance threshold
